feeds.detail: WordPress 7.1. REST exposes an `events` post type but its ACF fields are empty to an unauthenticated client, so no start or end time is available. /events/feed/ 404s and /events/?ical=1 returns HTML. Needs an ICS export plugin, or ACF date fields exposed to REST.

Drupal, but not Princeton Site Builder and with no iCal view enabled. Checked the bare apex too: cs.princeton.edu 301s to www.cs.princeton.edu, so it is the same host rather than a second one. /feeds/events/ical.ics, /events/ical, /ical, /calendar/ical and /events/export/ical all 404 on both spellin

WordPress 7.1. REST exposes `conference` and `eng_event` post types; `eng_event` carries an `acf` object that is empty unauthenticated, so no event dates are available. /events/feed/ 404s and /events/?ical=1 returns HTML.

WordPress 7.1. /events/feed/ does return RSS with 10 items, but its pubDate is the post publication date rather than the event date, so it cannot produce a calendar. REST exposes a `metroevents` type (rest_base `event`) whose ACF fields are empty unauthenticated.
